verdict.rationale: Bench documents real-time reports and dashboards in its own UI, plus an AI Categorization Assistant that only classifies transactions. Nothing shows an agent answering affordability questions, or a public API exposing live ledger data. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
